name: auditing-agent-skills
description: Audits existing Agent Skills for things that have gone out of date or drifted: retired model names, references to skills that were renamed or removed, naming drift, weak descriptions, dated facts, overlapping skills, missing test cases, and skills the AI Registry doesn't record. Use when the user asks to check, audit, tidy or review their skills as a set, asks any question about one kind of drift across them (which skills are out of date, use old models, still point at renamed skills, overlap, or are missing from the registry), or for a scheduled skill audit. Not for building or reviewing a single skill (use applying-skill-best-practices), and never changes a skill without the user's approval.
